hooks.name: Incubation Discipline Check
hooks.description: Automatically review INCUBATION.md changes against publishing gate rules to prevent bypassing the forcing functions

action.prompt: Review the changes to INCUBATION.md against the publishing gate rules. Check: Are any ideas being moved too quickly (Cold to Warming before 72hrs)? Is Pull over the limit of 3? Are new entries properly distilled to one claim/tension/question in 4 lines or less? Are you organizing/categorizing instead of letting ideas sit? Flag any violations of the incubation discipline.
